topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't stop staring at the package on my desk. It's wrapped in simple brown paper, no frills, no bows. Just a note: "To my favorite teacher, with all my gratitude." My heart is pounding as I recognize the handwriting. It's from Sarah, the girl who used to sit in the back, rarely spoke, and struggled with every assignment. I can feel my hands trembling as I carefully peel back the tape. Inside, a beautifully framed photograph of us together during her graduation day, and a book, highlighted and annotated, the one I recommended to her last year. The weight of it, the unexpectedness, it's almost too much. I look around my classroom, empty now, and a single tear escapes. All those hours, all those efforts, seeing it recognized like this... I need to compose myself. I have a class coming in soon.
